exposure: Mode of delivery (vaginal vs. caesarean section)
Colonization with different bacterial species and strains
outcome: Competition and synergistic relationships between bacterial species
Colonization potential of extra-intestinal pathogenic Escherichia coli (ExPEC) in comparison with their propensity to cause bloodstream infections
finding: The study identified strong inter- and intra-species competition dynamics in the neonatal gut colonisation process, as well as synergistic relationships between species, but found no evidence of preferential colonisation by hospital-adapted pathogen lineages in either vaginal or caesarean section birth groups.
mod_finding: No evidence of preferential colonisation by hospital-adapted pathogen lineages was detected in either vaginal or caesarean section birth groups.
